## Critique
- claim-1: Not established as stated. It includes \(\rho=(2,2)\), but the Strategy explicitly says that case is not independently certified. Moreover, only two sample Pieri expansions are supplied; the more complicated displayed identities lack complete expansions showing cancellation after truncation to \(5^5\). The ideal \(J\) is also not defined, so membership of every right-hand Schur factor is merely asserted.
- claim-2: The conclusion that the all-\(\rho\) certificate is not established is correct, but \(\rho=(3,3)\) is not the only missing case: \(\rho=(2,2)\) is also missing. Additionally, the proposed \(\rho=(3,3)\) target has the wrong sign: since \(|(3,3)|=6\), the required difference is
  \[
  \bar s_{555}-\bar s_{33333},
  \]
  not their sum.

## Repair certificates
- [proof-attempt] In
  \[
  A=\Lambda/I_{5,5},\qquad
  J=\bigoplus_{333\subseteq\lambda\subseteq5^5}\mathbb Z\bar s_\lambda,
  \]
  supply explicit integral Pieri identities for both missing cases
  \[
  \bar s_{553}-\bar s_{33322}\in A_+J,\qquad
  \bar s_{555}-\bar s_{33333}\in A_+J,
  \]
  and give complete truncated Pieri expansions for all ten \(\rho\subseteq3^2\), verifying every coefficient, cancellation, \(1\le t\le5\), and \(333\subseteq\lambda_k\subseteq5^5\).
- [computation] Alternatively, provide ordered Schur bases and complete Pieri matrices \(M_d\) for \(9\le d\le15\), with rows labelled by \((t,\lambda)\), and explicit integral vectors \(c_\rho\) satisfying
  \[
  c_\rho^{T}M_{9+|\rho|}
  =e_{R_{\rho'}}-(-1)^{|\rho|}e_{L_\rho}
  \]
  for every \(\rho\subseteq3^2\).

## Required revisions
- Remove \((2,2)\) from claim-1 unless its missing identity is supplied.
- Correct the \((3,3)\) sign.
- Define \(A,J,L_\rho,R_{\rho'}\) and handle \(\rho=\varnothing\) explicitly.
- Conclude only that the requested certificate is not yet established.
